newsitem.title: USA: USG spot jet diffs dip, traders eye American talks - Feb 13.
newsitem.headline: USG spot jet diffs dip, traders eye American talks - Feb 13.

text.p: U.S. Gulf Coast spot jet fuel prices eased lower Thursday as market players closely eyed news regarding the possible American Airlines' pilot strike at midnight Friday.
Traders said a work stoppage by the American pilots would probably trigger a drop in prices because American typically uses about 140,000 barrels a day, about 10 percent of the total U.S. demand.

USG 54-grade barrels for delivery on the back 4th cycle of the Colonial Pipeline changed hands at 3.50 cents over the screen, though offers appeared to firm slightly above that mark by the end of the day.
Traders said those barrels had jumped to as high as 5.00 cents over the screen during Wednesday's action.
New York Harbor prompt 54-grade jet fuel was talked on either side of 6.00 cents, traders said, in modest activity.
